reviews.text: The best place for your pets
They don't accept pit bulls for daycare and boarding. It's terrible that they discriminate based on the dog's breed.

I am more than satisfied with the result I've achieved with my dog ​​Moka. She's a Labrador mix I rescued. She wasn't socialized and had mobility issues due to the conditions she lived in before coming into my life. Since I decided to rescue her, this presented a challenge because I already have two small breed dogs: a 14-year-old Schnauzer and a nearly 10-year-old Westie. When I brought Moka (the name I gave her after rescuing her) to my apartment, I remembered there was a Canine Intelligence school very close by. I went to ask for information, and the person in charge was very kind and gave me all the information I needed. So, I decided to trust them to help me achieve my dream of welcoming Moka into my family.

Raúl, who is in charge and also the trainer, has done an extraordinary job, dedicating time to patiently teaching her to trust herself and other dogs. She also learned commands so she can be guided on the street or in enclosed areas. She's truly a different dog, a complete 180-degree change that I couldn't have achieved on my own in such a short time.

It's worth mentioning that all the staff at the branch where Moka stayed were very attentive, responsible, and above all, very loving towards her. I am more than grateful and happy to have had their help in achieving my goal. If I ever decide to rescue another dog in the future, I won't hesitate to request their services, if needed, to bring her into my family. Today we all live together, and Moka is very happy to be part of our family.
Excellent place for your pets. The staff are very friendly.
Every time Dasha arrives at daycare she's filled with joy, I'm so grateful that they give my little one so much love 💕🐾 …
The pack is amazing, empathetic, responsible, and above all… they love the dogs! Thank you!

I've used their training and daycare services, and it's always been a great experience. They even keep track of vaccination and deworming schedules to ensure a safe environment for all the dogs. My little one always comes out happy :)

Excellent school and great attention from everyone. Raúl is a very good coach and Rafa is super attentive.

Jack was the happiest at the school.

Thank you!

My two dogs are hyperactive and have a lot of energy. Nothing has helped them manage their anxiety better than attending Canine Intelligence Parroquia. All the instructors are very attentive, and the dogs are happy to go every day. Excellent service; they are always willing to help with the dogs' needs.

If you have the opportunity to enroll your fur babies at @inteligenciacanina, DO NOT. The service is terrible and the care is poor. I enrolled two of my dogs for $43,778 in boarding, and the day they completed their levels, they kicked them out and tried to charge me extra for boarding fees—those crooks!

During boarding, they never called us to check on their progress. I paid for the three levels they advertised, claiming they were doing well. During boarding and training, one of my dogs had bloody diarrhea every time we saw him. We spent money on vets there and outside, and he still hasn't gotten better. They called me twice about my other dog because she got an infection from the other dogs in her mouth. We spent money on an in-house vet. She fell while "playing" and hit her head. They asked me to deworm my other dogs, and coincidentally, they also added a deworming treatment for one of my females. When I complained about my pet being hospitalized, they told me, "It's true, I made a mistake." 🐀
They charge you for everything, they steal the food, they asked us for a 13-kilo bag of Royal Canin a week, and conveniently, it ran out super fast.

Now they refuse to give me my refund. Besides mistreating the animals, they try to squeeze money out of you at every opportunity.

‼️‼️‼️BE CAREFUL AND DON'T LEAVE YOUR PETS THERE‼️‼️‼️

I'm giving them less because I can't. It's unbelievable that they offer doggy daycare services, but the moment you mention it's a pit bull, they immediately tell you they're banned or only accept puppies (because they can't even agree on their own lies). And no, they didn't ask about my dog's temperament at all; only about her breed, weight, and age, and that was their answer.

AWFUL.
Great service, friendly staff and excellent facilities, our furry friends have a wonderful time

Excellent service at this branch. Communication with the staff is great; they keep us updated on everything happening with our little one, in addition to sharing photos of his stay. He always arrives and leaves happy, which confirms the wonderful care they provide. From the moment we arrive, he's very attentive, and you can feel his calm and excitement about arriving. All the trainers show appreciation and patience with the children. I highly recommend it.

Excellent service! I went there for my dog's bath and haircut, and everything was great. The service was very good, and I appreciated the staff's attention. They were all very attentive from the moment I entered the premises, and when my dog ​​came out of the bath, she smelled amazing! I highly recommend it and will definitely return. 💯

I've lowered my rating to 3 stars.

At first, the experience was excellent, but after the previous staff left, the service became impersonal, and my dog ​​started showing resistance upon entering and developing health problems. I decided to move her to another location.

—
It's simply exceptional! The communication is impeccable; they keep me informed about everything, providing invaluable peace of mind. When I pick up my dog, she's always happy, confirming that her time at the doggy daycare is pure bliss.

From the moment we arrive, the joy and dedication of Irving and Lulu create a welcoming atmosphere. Irving, the manager, shows a clear love for dogs, attending to Bruna's individual needs with patience and warmth. Lulu, always enthusiastic, makes sure that every dog ​​feels loved.

Taking great care of our fur babies—we had previous experience with an older dog and now with a puppy too. We feel safe; the little one enjoys it and we always send them photos or videos of how they behave. They do special activities that they love, and we do too.
I love it when my dogs arrive happy at daycare!

The daycare, as I call it, has been an extraordinary support in Bruni's life and mine. She burns off all her energy there and is becoming more and more sociable. She comes with me to watch tennis and eats very well. She always arrives happily, and after eating some croquettes for dessert, she settles down on the sofa for a nap.

Thank you so much for your support and love for my princess. I'm sending you a picture of Bruni watching the tennis match between Alcaraz and Musetti.
My dog ​​behaves much better thanks to them; he is cleaner and more obedient. I highly recommend them.
My dog ​​leaves very happy and I thank the caregivers for being very patient and caring.
Excellent service, they take great care of the dogs, and they always look so happy when they're there 🐕❤️ …
The truth is that the service is really wow, the caregivers are excellent people, and they know how to treat the dogs; everything is tailored to the needs I'm looking for for my pet.

Excellent service and attention from the staff. I really appreciate that they keep track of their vaccinations and the facilities where they can roam freely and under supervision. Kira is returning very happy. Thank you so much!
Excellent service and treatment of pets. Highly recommended.

I love Brenda at the parish; she's the sweetest with the dogs. The girls who work with her are great too. What I do think they should change is the veterinarians, because they're very inexperienced and don't care about the dogs.

They have such a great time that when I pick them up they don't want to leave! The service is wonderful! We are very happy with all their services.
🐶🐶🐶✨ …
My dogs have settled in well and the service is very good.

Hi, they have great service for our furry friends! I recommend this branch for their daycare, boarding, but especially for their effective and good training programs, and the packages they offer are affordable for us! 🐶🐶🐶🐶🐶 I like it! …
Excellent treatment of our pets, the staff's attention was outstanding. Very attentive, the pets clearly learn and are cared for and treated with love as they should be 💗 …
My dog ​​loves being here, they take great care of him, it's like being at home!
Terrible!! They discriminated against my mixed-breed dog for being a pitbull mix, arguing that "they don't have trained staff for these breeds"

I want to thank the IC team for how well they took care of my girl. My dog ​​is adopted and has always been very nervous.

However, just a few hours after she was admitted, they sent me a video where I could clearly see that my dog ​​was happy, playing, and doing things she does when she's happy.

For those of us who love our dogs, having a place like this is invaluable.

I highly recommend it!
Show the commitment you should have as a company. Start with cleaning because it stinks; just walking past it smells really, really bad.
I love that my dog ​​comes out so happy ♡
Excellent option for leaving our dogs, they are very attentive and always return super happy and tired ☺️
Good service

A great option for both daycare and boarding. They've always taken excellent care of our little one, and both Irving and Lulu have always provided the best attention. They also have really fun activities for dogs during the holidays.
We're so grateful to have found a place where we can leave our dog safely for several days when needed.

Until January 31, 2024, my dog ​​was at Inteligencia Canina Parroquia. Yesterday, January 31, when I went to pay the monthly fee, without any prior notice from the manager, Irving, I learned that the monthly fee had increased from 4200 to …

The service and care for the pets is excellent. Unfortunately, the management never notified me of the monthly fee increase, and I only found out when I went to pay. My complaint wasn't about the increase itself, but rather the percentage …
Expensive, very good service, but expensive. They give the dogs the attention they can for 3 caregivers and 40 or more dogs.
